children: Irish annual consumer price inflation rose to 3.4% in August from 3.1% a month earlier following an 4.3% month-on-month jump in energy prices, a flash estimate of the Harmonised Index of Consumer Prices showed on Monday.

Prices rose by 0.6% between July and August on the renewed energy price pressures, the fastest monthly jump since March, the Central Statistics Office data showed. Excluding energy and unprocessed food, price growth slowed year-on-year to 2.6%.
